# @vllnt/logger

> Small structured logging package for the @vllnt ecosystem. Emits JSON log entries, has zero runtime dependencies, and never throws from a log call.

Scoped events (`auth.login`), levels `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, and pluggable synchronous outputs. The Node.js backend preset reads `LOG_LEVEL` from `process.env` on each call and defaults to `warn`. There is no built-in redaction. ESM only.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/logger/docs/`, with the TypeScript sources in `node_modules/@vllnt/logger/src/`. They match the installed version. Read them before writing code.

## Docs

- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Every public export, its signature and an example, per entry point
- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, entry points and design decisions
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes

## Entry points

- `@vllnt/logger`: core API and Node.js backend preset (`createBackendLogger`)
- `@vllnt/logger/convex`: `createConvexLogger`, no `process.env` access
- `@vllnt/logger/posthog`: `createPostHogOutput`
- `@vllnt/logger/testing`: `createTestOutput`
